note: Sources opened: ABRSM, RCM, Trinity ebook store, Faber/Peters, Alfred and Mel Bay product pages/feeds; Forsyths (ISBN, pages, contents); Engadine, Turra (AMEB; ameb.edu.au returns 403); ANZCA and RIAM shops; RCM Violin Syllabus 2021 PDF (étude lists pp. 36–74, bibliography p. 94); Wikipedia (Woof, Kinsey); IMSLP. Eight web searches used. Trinity's Strings syllabus from June 2025 (PDF, p. 13) confirms the 2016 book is still its technical-work publication. Not reachable: ameb.edu.au, conservatorycanada.ca, catalogue.nli.ie, prestomusic, thesoundpost, stretta-music. Findings by board: ABRSM publishes only the 2012 per-grade scale books (Gr 1–8) plus old study books by Woof and Kinsey. Trinity has one book (2016, Initial–Gr 8). RCM 2021 has three Technique, Etudes, and Musicianship volumes (Prep–2, 3–4, 5–8) and none for Levels 9–10; the 2013 edition split Prep–4 and 5–8; Celebration Series Perspectives is a piano line. AMEB has only the Technical Workbook (2021; 2011 edition not listed twice); Series 9/10 grade books are repertoire. ANZCA and RIAM have scale books. LCME, Guildhall, ASTA, NYSSMA, UIL publish no exercise books (see skipped). Authorship/levels: board books use the board as corporate author (no editor credited, 'dates' blank); 'Various' only for the uncredited Novello scale book. Whole-range volumes (Initial/Prep–Gr 8) are given a mid-range level; RCM 3–4 and Superstudies Book 2 (Faber Gr 2–4) straddle the floor and are marked medium confidence. Faber's Mary Cohen and Paul Harris pages state nationality British. Derek Collier (Faber scale book) may or may not be the Bournemouth SO leader (1927–2008); not linked, so no dates given. The RCM shop 'Contents' field for The Complete Violin Technique Book and for Shifting lists fiddle-tune titles (apparent data error); author, year and description come from the RCM syllabus bibliography (p. 94) and the shop descriptions. 'exams' on my entries are real syllabus placements (RCM 2021 lists) or the board's own grade; for existing rows the missing RCM placements are in existing_issues. Edition notes: ABRSM scales sold since July 2011 for the 2012 syllabus (Forsyths); Trinity print 31 July 2015; pre-2012 ABRSM and pre-2016 Trinity editions not found online.
